shared_elements: horizontal registers of small carved sign-groups (script)
low-relief incised carving of figures (a standing human figure at the left edge in B, standing figures in A)
justification: Both are upright rectangular inscribed fields dominated by stacked horizontal lines of small carved sign-groups, with at least one standing human figure rendered in shallow relief, which is a reasonably specific shared scheme of pictorial panel plus ruled text. The decisive difference is that A preserves a legible figural scene — a standing deity-like figure facing a bowing worshipper with raised arms across an offering stand, occupying the upper third — while B shows no comparable interaction, its surface being almost entirely text with only a marginal figure.
